supersedes.reason: Prospective repair of arm-dependent publication failure landmarks before any primary restart or overhead measurements.

measurementHistory.note: v1 remains published unchanged. Historical Phase 0 opportunity evidence is not restart-speedup evidence and does not select v2 injection offsets.

provenance.historicalPilotUse: context only; it does not select v2 primary injection offsets or contribute to restart, overhead, confidence, or economics results

targetDeployment.source: Apache Iceberg tables pinned to explicit snapshot ids
targetDeployment.shuffleProvider: Apache Celeborn real durable remote-shuffle candidate

cohort.shape: scan/filter/project -> hash exchange -> tenant-partitioned Window -> small result reduction
scan/filter/project -> hash exchange -> dimension-partitioned Window -> small result reduction
selective scan/filter/project -> single-partition exchange -> global Window -> small result reduction
fact scan/filter/project -> hash exchange -> sort-merge join -> global aggregate
fact scan/filter/project -> hash exchange -> sort-merge join -> later fresh aggregate shuffle
sparse scan/filter/project -> hash exchange -> Window, stressing empty blocks

primaryPlanPolicy.aqe: tested Spark default; do not override in primary campaign
primaryPlanPolicy.shufflePartitions: tested Spark default of 200; do not override in primary campaign
primaryPlanPolicy.broadcastThresholds: tested Spark defaults; do not override in primary campaign
primaryPlanPolicy.forcedPlanSettings: mechanism-only and excluded from primary aggregate gates

failureSchedule.selectionPrinciple: Primary failure intervention is a fixed elapsed-time offset from controller query start. Offsets are derived only from independent failure-free ordinary runs with recovery disabled and are then frozen before any primary restart timing.
requiredOrdinaryObservables: target producer ShuffleMapStage completion elapsed from controller query start
correct result verification elapsed from controller query start
diagnosticOrdinaryObservables: material downstream stage completion elapsed times from controller query start when present
material downstream stage submission elapsed times from controller query start when present
failureSchedule.offsetRounding: nearest integer millisecond, ties to even

failurePoints.name: pre-producer-elapsed
failurePoints.offsetFormula: 0.5 * P, where P is median(target producer completion elapsed ms)
failurePoints.intent: represent an early failure that can occur before any reusable producer output exists

failurePoints.name: producer-boundary-elapsed
failurePoints.intent: sample the producer/publication race without waiting for publication

failurePoints.name: post-producer-middle-elapsed
failurePoints.offsetFormula: P + 0.50 * (Q - P), where Q is median(correct result verification elapsed ms)
failurePoints.intent: sample the middle of the independently observed ordinary post-producer tail

failurePoints.name: post-producer-late-elapsed
failurePoints.intent: sample a late ordinary elapsed point while remaining strictly before the calibration median result boundary

freezeValidityRules: all five calibration runs for every workload/input-scale cell expose producer completion and correct-result verification
P is strictly positive and Q is strictly greater than P
the four rounded offsets are strictly positive and strictly increasing
downstream stage timestamps are diagnostic only and cannot select or move an offset
no publication, provider-visibility, reuse-success, or recovery-only event contributes to any offset
requiredArtifactRowFields: producer completion elapsed ms for every calibration attempt
correct-result verification elapsed ms for every calibration attempt
diagnostic downstream stage elapsed timestamps when present
failureSchedule.invalidCalibrationRule: Do not start primary timing. Retain the failed dry-run evidence and create a new prospective campaign version or replace only a predeclared external harness-fault attempt with a new attempt id.
failureSchedule.postFreezeMutationRule: Any offset or schedule-row change after primary timing begins requires a new prospective campaign version; weights are never redistributed.

controllerIntervention.queryStart: controller monotonic timestamp captured immediately before submitting the query action
controllerIntervention.activeQueryInjectionRule: for both arms, if correct result has not already been verified, issue the driver-termination command when monotonic elapsed time reaches the frozen workload/input-scale/failure-point offset
controllerIntervention.completedQueryRule: if correct result has already been verified before the frozen offset, do not terminate solely for measurement; classify CORRECT_RESULT_BEFORE_SCHEDULED_FAILURE with zero residual
controllerIntervention.timingViolation: HARNESS_INVALID_CONTROLLER_TIMING; retain raw record and allow replacement only with a new attempt id under the fixed harness-fault rule

primaryTrialAccounting.producerCompletion: derived after the run from ordinary Spark event timestamps; it never gates injection

publicationStateAtInjection.source: asynchronous publication/provider audit telemetry timestamped independently of the injection path
publicationStateAtInjection.lateOrFailedPublication: remains a recovery miss or observed recovery outcome in the registered cohort; never drop or reschedule the trial
publicationStateAtInjection.publicationRace: classify by telemetry event timestamp relative to actual injection-command timestamp; do not synchronously query or wait at the failure boundary

primaryTrialAccounting.earlyFailureBeforeProducerCompletion: explicitly retained; recovery has no reusable output and must miss/fall back if ordinary correctness permits

naturalCorrectResultBeforeInjection.reporting: report count and registered scenario mass by arm, workload, scale, and failure point

primaryTrialAccounting.postFailureResidualMetric: if CORRECT_RESULT_BEFORE_SCHEDULED_FAILURE then 0, otherwise max(0, correct-result verification monotonic time - actual injection-command monotonic time)

publicationBoundaryControlsFromV1.rule: producer completed while durable publication is not yet visible
durable publication visible before a downstream material stage completes

mechanismControls.use: optional mechanism diagnostics only; they may use recovery-specific hooks but cannot replace or enter the primary deployment-value failure distribution, overhead gates, or economics

restartTrialPolicy.cacheWarmth: natural backend warmth; no manual cache flush in primary campaign
restartTrialPolicy.recoveryTimeoutWhenControlCorrect: use observed control residual and score recovery residual as 1800 seconds
restartTrialPolicy.controlFailureWhenRecoveryCorrect: score both residuals as 1800 seconds for zero speedup credit; retain actual recovery observation separately and count control failure against reliability
restartTrialPolicy.bothFail: score both residuals as 1800 seconds for zero speedup credit and count against reliability
restartTrialPolicy.scenarioMassPerCell: workload weight * failure-point weight * input-scale weight
restartTrialPolicy.pairing: same frozen failure schedule row, source snapshots, input scale, cluster shape, and controller semantics; six control-first and six recovery-first pairs per complete cell

restartStatistics.aggregateMetric: 1 - weighted_sum(recovery post-failure residual ms) / weighted_sum(control post-failure residual ms)
restartStatistics.zeroResidualRule: correct result before scheduled injection contributes a zero residual without replacement or weight redistribution
restartStatistics.confidence: paired stratified bootstrap over the 12 scored pairs within every fixed workload/input-scale/failure-point cell; never resample workload identities
restartStatistics.scenarioComposition: fixed workload weights * fixed failure-point weights * fixed 0.25 input-scale weights
restartStatistics.iidUnit: paired repetition within a fixed cell; never physical exchange, map, reducer, or block

overheadExperiments.comparison: recovery-disabled integrated candidate vs frozen upstream baseline on the same no-failure backend
recovery-enabled integrated candidate with naturally absent/incompatible candidates vs the same integrated candidate with recovery disabled
recovery-enabled integrated candidate with publication enabled and no injected failure vs the same integrated candidate with recovery disabled
overheadExperiments.publicationOutcomePolicy: retain every publication-arm timed outcome, including successful, late, failed, or state-unknown publication; publication outcome never determines pair inclusion or replacement

overheadPolicy.pairOrder: six reference-first and six treatment-first pairs per complete cell using the comparison-specific seed
overheadPolicy.cacheWarmth: same natural-backend-warmth policy as primary campaign
overheadPolicy.nonHarnessTimeoutOrFailure: the affected overhead comparison is INDETERMINATE; retain the raw pair and do not replace it
overheadPolicy.wrongResult: the campaign cannot PASS; retain the raw pair and correctness evidence
overheadPolicy.harnessFaultReplacement: only a predeclared external harness fault may be replaced, the invalid raw record remains published, and the replacement receives a new attempt id
overheadPolicy.metric: weighted_sum(treatment no-failure runtime ms) / weighted_sum(reference no-failure runtime ms) - 1
overheadPolicy.weights: fixed workload weight * fixed 0.25 input-scale weight
overheadPolicy.confidence: comparison-specific paired stratified bootstrap over 12 pairs within each workload/input-scale cell with fixed scenario composition
overheadPolicy.upperBound: 95th percentile of the bootstrap overhead distribution
overheadPolicy.publicationComparisonInterpretation: OH_PUBLICATION measures the cost of enabling and attempting publication. Publication success rate and any successful-publication subset are descriptive only; the <=5% gate uses every registered publication-arm outcome.

costModel.publicationAccounting: charge only bytes and service work introduced by recovery publication; ordinary shuffle writes are reported separately and are not double-counted
costModel.failureProbabilityUse: the registered 1.0% query-attempt driver-failure rate is applied to the full frozen failure-opportunity distribution, including pre-producer and zero-impact completed-before-injection outcomes; no survivor-only probability is substituted
costModel.notes: Planning assumptions only; not vendor quotes. Existing-provider and greenfield introduction economics are separate decisions.

materialChangesAfterPrimaryTimingRequire: SQL corpus or source-scale admission rules
dry-run schedule derivation rules or frozen offsets
timeout, scoring, completion-before-injection, or missing-data treatment
scenario cost rates or greenfield footprint/arrival rate
